plain_description.what: An engineering check. It caps every tree-building JVM and embedding run at 12 processor threads (half the machine), and checks that capped runs give byte-identical significance-test results and identical trees whether run with 12 or 8 threads.
plain_description.why: The author wants half the machine kept free, and the cap must not change any result.
plain_description.information: Passing shows results do not depend on the thread count, so the cap is safe to adopt. Result: blocked, not finished. The JVM legs passed: identical null-test output, trees deterministic, and the same at 12 and 8 threads (small AG_NEWS build only). The embedding-server (Ollama) leg was not run, and the standing adoption of the cap waits for the author.
